summary: Show Inbox activity as unavailable when no complete activity series exists

schema.detail: No daemon or generated-client contract changes.

rules.detail: Attention and human-review rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Inbox no longer presents a partial activity histogram as a complete series. It explicitly shows activity as unavailable until a complete series is supported.

manual.detail: No migration or user action is required.

recovery.detail: Restore the prior app package pin to roll back; daemon state is unchanged.
